Messages.Author: gu...@mail.goo.ne.jp
Messages.Body:
Howdy, I have 2 questions.

1. Concealed Weapon
When I play Concealed Weapon, I have to announce the weapon I am going
to equip from hand?

2. Ankara of Both Sides
A vampire with Ankara Citadel plays Jack of Both Sides and employ
Spiritual Protector. The net cost of this action is 1 (JoBS) + 3 (SP)
-2 (effect of JoBS) = 2 / 2 (AC) = 1 blood. Is this correct?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
gu...@mail.goo.ne.jp wrote:
> 1. Concealed Weapon
> When I play Concealed Weapon, I have to announce the weapon I am going
> to equip from hand?

Yes.

> 2. Ankara of Both Sides
> A vampire with Ankara Citadel plays Jack of Both Sides and employ
> Spiritual Protector. The net cost of this action is 1 (JoBS) + 3 (SP)
> -2 (effect of JoBS) = 2 / 2 (AC) = 1 blood. Is this correct?

1 (JoBS) / 2 (AC) = 0

So the action costs 0.

Then, when resolved, the action allows the vampire to employ SP:

3 (SP) / 2 (AC) = 1
1 - 2 (JoBS) = 0

So the employing costs 0.
